zh: 有没有人发现，微信下面那个“按住说话”的框，
en: Have you noticed WeChat's hold-to-talk box

zh: 颜色跟以前不一样了？
en: now looks different?

zh: 还有一个更惊人的功能啊。
en: There is an even more surprising feature.

zh: 聊天里的图片，你点一下，
en: Tap an image in a chat,

zh: 下面会出来一个“AI处理”。
en: and an AI Processing option appears.

zh: 美化、提取信息、修改图片，都在里面。
en: It can enhance, extract information, and edit the image.

zh: 它可以把一张图片的风格直接改掉。
en: It can directly change the style of an image.

zh: 然后这里面用到的，
en: The model used here

zh: 可能是腾讯的混元生图模型。
en: may be Tencent's Hunyuan image model.

zh: 那么再往下，我问它：
en: Then I asked it:

zh: 我现在在兰州中心附近，四个人，不吃辣，
en: We are four people near Lanzhou Center and do not eat spicy food.

zh: 想吃清淡一点，最好就是减肥期也能吃。
en: We want something light that also fits a diet.

zh: 以前碰到这种问题，我们四个人可能就要开始分工了。
en: Before, the four of us would split up the search.

zh: 一个刷短视频，一个翻评论，
en: One checked short videos and another read reviews.

zh: 一个打开地图，还有一个问朋友。
en: One opened a map, and another asked a friend.

zh: 这次它先给到了几个方向，
en: This time, it first suggested a few directions,

zh: 然后直接把位置落到了地图上。
en: then placed the options directly on a map.

zh: 点进一家店，后面接着就是门店的小程序、
en: Open a store, and its mini program follows,

zh: 菜单和点餐页面。
en: along with the menu and ordering page.

zh: 老板们，到这儿看明白了没有？
en: Business owners, do you see the point?

zh: 这里最值得我们研究的，不是它推荐了哪家店，
en: What matters is not which store it recommended,

zh: 是用户问完一句话之后，
en: but whether, after one request,

zh: 他有没有一条路能继续地往店里面走。
en: the user has a path that continues toward the store.

zh: 这条路径对做餐饮、零售和本地服务的人，
en: For restaurants, retail, and local services,

zh: 已经够值得看了。
en: this path is already worth watching.

zh: 以前，客户是在各个平台里面一点一点地找你。
en: Before, customers found you bit by bit across platforms.

zh: 以后，他可能把“我在哪儿、几个人、想吃什么、
en: In future, they may state their location, group size, and food preference,

zh: 忌不忌口、预算大概多少”，
en: along with dietary restrictions and budget,

zh: 一口气地说给AI。
en: all in one request to AI.

zh: AI把范围收一收，给出几个能对上需求的选择，
en: AI narrows the range and offers matching options,

zh: 再把人带到地图和店铺页面。
en: then takes the user to the map and store page.

zh: 抖音、小红书、评价当然都还会看。
en: People will still check Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and reviews.

zh: 不是说以后谁都没用了。
en: This does not make every other channel useless.

zh: 只是用户多了一条更短的路：
en: Users simply gain a shorter route:

zh: 先问一问，再进去。
en: ask first, then enter.

zh: GEO在这里面干什么？
en: What does GEO do here?

zh: 别把GEO想得太玄了。
en: Do not make GEO sound mysterious.

zh: 它其实就是，你理解成这样：
en: Think of it this way:

zh: AI在回答别人的问题之前，
en: before AI answers someone,

zh: 能不能把你这家店认清楚。
en: can it correctly understand your store?

zh: 你在哪儿、几点营业、主打什么、适合谁，
en: Where are you, when are you open, what do you offer, and for whom?

zh: 菜单还准不准、能不能订位，
en: Is the menu current, and can customers reserve?

zh: 小程序能不能打开，这些东西是不是一回事。
en: Does the mini program open, and do all these details agree?

zh: 如果地图写的是老地址，
en: If the map shows an old address,

zh: 店里早就改了营业时间，
en: the store has changed its opening hours,

zh: 网上还是你去年的菜单，
en: and the web still shows last year's menu,

zh: 客户点进来之后连入口都找不到，
en: customers may click in and fail to find an entry point.

zh: 那么AI就算把你提出来了，
en: Even if AI mentions you,

zh: 这一步你也接不住。
en: you still cannot receive the customer at this step.

zh: 所以GEO不是让AI硬推你，
en: So GEO is not about forcing AI to promote you.

zh: 是先把真实的你，
en: It first puts the real version of your business

zh: 放到AI能看懂、也能对得上的地方。
en: where AI can understand and verify it.

zh: 你再回头看看之前录屏里面的“AI处理”。
en: Look again at AI Processing in the recording.

zh: 就是图片以后，也不只是给人看了。
en: Images will no longer be only for people to view.

zh: 你的菜单图、活动海报、门头介绍，
en: Your menu images, posters, and storefront introductions

zh: 里面的地址、日期、价格写错了，
en: may contain incorrect addresses, dates, or prices.

zh: 工具读到的也可能就是错了。
en: Then the tool may also read the wrong information.

zh: 现在就是店里，别只盯着图漂不漂亮了。
en: Stores should not focus only on whether the image looks good.

zh: 该更新的要更新，
en: Update what needs updating,

zh: 该统一的要统一。
en: and align what needs aligning.

zh: 接下来说AAO。
en: Now let us talk about AAO.

zh: 我用大白话给大家解释一下：
en: In plain language:

zh: AI已经把人提前送到你的面前了。
en: AI has already brought the person to you earlier in the journey.

zh: 你有没有地方能让它继续办事？
en: Do you have somewhere for them to continue the task?

zh: 想找店，能进地图；
en: To find the store, they can open the map.

zh: 想看菜单，能看到真实的菜单；
en: To view the menu, they can see the real menu.

zh: 然后想订位、点餐、问停车，
en: For reservations, ordering, or parking questions,

zh: 能进到对应的页面，或者是有人接。
en: they reach the right page or a real person.

zh: 这就是我这一次AAO想说的事。
en: That is what I mean by AAO here.

zh: 它不是让AI替老板把整家店管了。
en: It does not mean AI runs the whole store for the owner.

zh: 它是把客人下一步要做的那件小事接住。
en: It catches the customer's next small task.

zh: 未来这条路要是接得更顺，
en: If this route becomes smoother,

zh: 用户可能不用再一个软件一个软件地翻了。
en: users may no longer need to browse app by app.

zh: AI会按照习惯和这次的需求，
en: AI can use habits and the current need

zh: 然后把选择收窄。
en: to narrow the choices.

zh: 最后确认一下，或者是输入一次支付密码，
en: The user confirms once, or enters a payment password,

zh: 这事就办成了。
en: and the task is done.

zh: 对消费者来说，少翻一点、少比一点，
en: For consumers, there is less browsing and comparison,

zh: 找到的东西也更贴近自己这次真实要解决的问题。
en: and the result better matches the current real need.

zh: 那么对于商家来说，
en: For merchants,

zh: 你也别先被“Agent”“自动化”这些给唬住了。
en: do not be intimidated by words like Agent and automation.

zh: 你今天先把这四件事看一遍：
en: Start by checking four things today:

zh: 地图定位准不准，
en: Is the map location accurate?

zh: 网上的信息是不是同一套，
en: Is the information online consistent?

zh: 小程序或者是预约点餐的入口能不能用，
en: Do the mini program, reservation, and ordering entry points work?

zh: 出了问题到底谁负责。
en: Who is responsible when something goes wrong?

zh: 先把一条路跑顺。
en: First, make one route work end to end.

zh: 比如客户从地图进来，能不能找到你；
en: Can a customer entering from the map find you?

zh: 想订位的时候，能不能顺利地订上；
en: Can they successfully make a reservation?

zh: 问到一个问题，店里有没有人能给他准话。
en: Can someone in the store give a definite answer?

zh: 这些小事你都没有接住的话，
en: If these small tasks are not handled,

zh: 上来就谈复杂的AI，
en: starting with complex AI

zh: 花钱不一定少，但是客户也未必更方便。
en: may still cost a lot without making life easier for customers.

zh: 所以这个GEO是让AI看见你、敢介绍你。
en: GEO helps AI see you and feel able to introduce you.

zh: AAO是AI介绍完以后，客户别走丢。
en: AAO keeps the customer from getting lost after the introduction.

zh: 讲到这儿，想必做AI应用落地的朋友们，
en: By now, people implementing AI applications

zh: 大概也看到了一个方向，
en: have probably seen a direction

zh: 也知道自己接下来该干什么。
en: and know what to do next.

zh: 至于企业老板，我想也大概能看明白，
en: Business owners can probably also see

zh: AI大爆发时代如何布局。
en: how to prepare in this AI boom.

zh: 我把GEO和AAO的整套讲解课程已经整理好了。
en: I have organized the complete GEO and AAO course materials.

zh: 做餐饮、零售、本地服务的朋友，
en: For people in restaurants, retail, and local services,

zh: 评论区留下“GEO”，我免费发给大家。
en: comment GEO and I will send it to you for free.

zh: 我是超哥，在兰州AI创业。
en: I am Chao Ge, building an AI business in Lanzhou.
